name: mirror
description: A local look at how you work with AI. Optional nudge after a long run without questioning the AI. Counts only; never stores or sends what you write.

interface.shortDescription: A local look at how you work with AI
interface.longDescription: Counts patterns in your own prompts and, only if you turn it on, shows one line after a long run without a question or pushback. Stores counts and times only; never your text; no network.
